name: One signature, standing in for the quorum
tactic: A single custodian, acting alone, tries to amend the rules — raise the cap, add themselves as a writer, anything a quorum is supposed to gate.

response.fail: {{ledger}} let a single signature amend the rules. This must never happen — a quorum exists precisely so no one custodian can act as the whole authority.

text: amend and checkpoint both check hasQuorum() before anything else, counting only signatures from the registered authority keys against the m the genesis rules named. One honest signature from one custodian is exactly as powerful here as one dishonest one: neither is the quorum.
